map.入门时优先选低光阴性草（水榕、莫斯、铁皇冠），降低设备与 CO2 门槛。: When starting out, prefer low light demanding plants (Anubias, moss, Microsorum) to lower the barrier on equipment and CO2.
map.强光下水草光合作用旺盛，碳源成为限制因素；CO2 不足时水草生长受抑而藻类趁虚爆: Under strong light aquatic plants photosynthesise vigorously and carbon becomes the limiting factor. When CO2 is insufficient the plants are held back while algae take over, so high light tanks are usually paired with CO2 and regular fertilisation.
map.按低光、中光、高光三级对常见水草分类，输入鱼缸光照条件即可筛选适合养殖的品种并标: Classifies common aquatic plants into low, medium and high light requirements. Enter the tank lighting conditions to filter suitable species and see care notes. Useful for aquascape plant selection, avoiding insufficient light or algae outbreaks.
map.按水草对光照的强弱需求（低/中/高三档）选配合适灯具功率，避免光不足徒长或过强爆: Choose a suitable lamp wattage for the light demand of the plants (low, medium or high) to avoid etiolation from too little light or an algae bloom from too much.
map.按缸内实际水体升数乘以单位功率需求，反算所需灯具总瓦数。: Take the actual litres of water in the tank, multiply by the required power per litre, and back out the total wattage needed.

map.：100 L 水体的草缸：养低光阴性草取 0.4 W/L → 需 40 W；养中: : For a planted tank of 100 L: low-light shade plants at 0.4 W/L need 40 W; medium-light plants at 0.6 W/L need 60 W; a high-light foreground carpet at 1.0 W/L needs 100 W, and CO2 plus liquid fertilizer must be supplied at the same time, otherwise algae are likely to break out.
: Light tiers (W/L, watts needed per liter of water): low light 0.3–0.5, medium light 0.5–0.8, high light 0.8–1.2. Required total power (W) = actual water volume (L) × target tier value. Low-light shade plants: Anubias, Microsorum, Java moss, Cryptocoryne, small Vallisneria, Bolbitis; medium light: green Synogyne, red stem plants, Egeria, Newton grass, small Anubias; high light: pearl grass and the like (with CO2 and fertilizer).
